messages:
sam_client: Hey support — noticed a billing spike. Our node SDK v1.3.2 estimator reports ~420 tokens for this request but invoice shows ~2,800. Happening across a few calls. Repro below, can someone help triage?

sam_client: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a concise assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the attached file."}],"stream":true}'

alex_support: Thanks — do you have an example request_id / x-request-id from a spike invoice line? Also, does your SDK estimator include system messages and function/tool call tokens?

sam_client: I grabbed an invoice line: invoice_item_id=inv_ABC123, request header x-request-id=rq_20240321_77f. SDK estimator code is the helper from examples, just calls estimateTokens(messages). It returns 420.

mj_engineer: Quick note: older SDKs used a simplified tokenizer and intentionally omitted server-injected system/tool messages (function args, return values, model tool calls). That can cause big deltas esp. with streaming + function calls.

lina_billing: Invoice-side check: We charge based on server tokenization which includes all bytes consumed by the model at generation time. I'll look up inv_ABC123 now.

alex_support: Can you repro a single non-streaming call (stream=false) and paste both client estimate and the server token header? Server should emit `x-token-count` in response headers for repro requests.

sam_client: Repro (non-stream):
``
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a concise assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize: <long document>"}],"stream":false}'
```

sam_client: Response headers include: `x-request-id: rq_20240321_77f`, `x-token-count: 2812`

mj_engineer: There you go — server counted system + kv cache + function-tool tokens for streaming session. Your SDK estimator (v1.3.2) undercounts system-role content and ignores tool-call outputs. Upgrade to v1.3.4 — estimator now mirrors server tokenization and adds a helper `estimateServerTokens(payload)`.

alex_support: Workaround: call our token preview endpoint `/v1/usage/preview` with the same payload to get server-side token counts before sending for production billing.

lina_billing: Confirmed inv_ABC123 maps to rq_20240321_77f and shows 2812 billed tokens. Billing is correct per server count. If you want refunds we need a documented mismatch and repro — upgrading SDK should fix future estimates.

sam_client: OK will upgrade and rerun. Any ETA on the SDK patch?

mj_engineer: Patch released. v1.3.4 published, docs updated. If you can't upgrade immediately use the preview endpoint.

deploy-bot: deploy started: sdk-publish/v1.3.4 by @mj_engineer :rocket:

sam_client: Thanks all — that explains it. Will confirm after upgrade :thumbsup:
